mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 1% in last month) does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), an elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, FEDFUNDS > 2.0% does not lead to negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850.0 (thousand units) signals weakening residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue outlook, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 850.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate severe labor market deterioration, reducing household income and consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS (down > 0.5%) and rise in UNRATE (up > 0.2pp) does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-demand regimes (RSAFS > 370000.0), a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 900.0) signals sector-specific demand weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 370000.0, HOUST < 900.0 does not lead to negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.
